experiments.study_type: genetically modified mouse line characterization and phenotypic assessment
experiments.procedure_text: Slc17a6-Cre-expressing mice were crossed to Argonaute2-floxed mice. Phenotypic analysis of Slc17a6-cre, Ago2 flox/flox mice included survival, body weight, brain MRI, histology, EM, and behavioral monitoring.
